instruction: Add a `--top N` option to wordfreq.py. After the usual summary line it should print the N most frequent words, one per line, as `<count> <word>`, with the counts right-aligned to the width of the largest count shown. Words with the same count go in alphabetical order. If N is larger than the number of distinct words, print them all. N must be at least 1: for 0 or a negative number, exit with argparse's usage error (status 2). Without --top, the output must stay exactly as it is now.
